purpose: Machine-readable key contract for the run records this suite writes. It is a validator input, not an example record: it contains no measurements and no illustrative values, so it cannot be mistaken for data. run_deterministic.py validates every record it writes against this file, and tests/skill_evals_acceptance.py validates it independently.

absence_markers.unknown: The field applies to this suite but has not been measured yet. A gap in eval-plan.json names what would close it.
absence_markers.not-applicable: The field cannot exist for this suite's design. A sibling field ending in _note states why.
absence_markers.not-observable: The field would require a session log or a user turn, and a script-driven run produces neither. A sibling field ending in _note states why.

forbidden: A zero, an empty list or a plausible-looking default standing in for an unmeasured value. Use an absence marker or omit the key and name the gap.
